bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for a youth mental health urgency room in Ramsey County.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; YOUTH MENTAL HEALTH URGENCY ROOM.

$1,600,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,600,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Ramsey County for the ongoing operation of the youth mental health urgency room established in Laws 2022, chapter 99, article 1, section 44.
